about: What the device keeps between launches. A page is written to the client's store only when its answer says it may be kept (`x-navree-keep: 1`, which the server sends when the page's `Cache-Control` does not say `no-store`); an answer that no longer says so removes what was kept for its address. At the next launch the kept shell is drawn at once, but a kept page waits until this launch's shell has answered over the network and named the same person: another person or nobody empties everything kept, and a shell that can't be reached means no kept page is drawn at all.
